This week marks 6 years at ClickUp. 🚀 Time flies when you're building something meaningful.

I've had the privilege of working alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people I've ever met. I'm deeply thankful for that.

On the customer side, I get to partner with enterprise organizations navigating real AI transformation, fundamentally rethinking how their teams operate. It's the most rewarding part of this role.

AND it's incredible to be at a company where the product keeps pace with those conversations. Brain 2.0 🧠 + what's ahead have me energized in a way that feels like year 1 again.

Here's to the next chapter! 🎉
